title: Moon Dust document: spherical objects recovered in New Zealand farmland

tellings.quote: One document describes the recovery of spherical objects in New Zealand farmland.

plain: A declassified government document is said to describe the recovery of round, ball-shaped objects from farmland in New Zealand. Michels tells this himself, as one of the documents tied to Moon Dust, a US government effort to recover objects that fell from space. He raises it because, if true, it would show that effort reaching far beyond America.
